name: bld4_card_orderOf_eq_prime_of_card_prime_mul_prime
statement: (p q : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (hq : q.Prime) (hpq : p < q) (G : Type*) [Group G] (hG : Nat.card G = p * q) (hna : ∃ a b : G, a * b ≠ b * a) : Nat.card {g : G // orderOf g = p} = q * (p - 1)
closed: ∀ (p q : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (hq : q.Prime) (hpq : p < q) (G : Type*) [Group G] (hG : Nat.card G = p * q) (hna : ∃ a b : G, a * b ≠ b * a), Nat.card {g : G // orderOf g = p} = q * (p - 1)
informal: Uses Mathlib2.bld3_card_sylow_of_card_prime_mul_prime: there are exactly q Sylow p-subgroups, each of order p; two distinct ones meet trivially, and every element of order p generates one. So the elements of order p are the disjoint union over the q Sylow p-subgroups of their p − 1 non-identity elements.
type: ∀ (p q : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)], Nat.Prime q → p < q → ∀ (G : Type u_1) [inst : Group G], Nat.card G = p * q → (∃ a b, a * b ≠ b * a) → Nat.card { g // orderOf g = p } = q * (p - 1)
